sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "start_time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_time" INTEGER NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general', "has_reminder" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_reminder" IN (0, 1)), "reminder_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10, "recurrence_rule" TEXT NULL, "all_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("all_day" IN (0, 1)), "recurrence_end" INTEGER NULL, "recurrence_exceptions" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projects" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_date" INTEGER NULL, "target_progress" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "progress_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "value" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), "status_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'todo', "start_date" INTEGER NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NULL, "estimated_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "diary_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "mood" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habits" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '🔥', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_per_week" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habit_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "habit_id" TEXT REFERENCES habits(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "focus_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "start_time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "todo_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "recurrence_rule" TEXT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES todo_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "project_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "reminder_at" INTEGER NULL, "estimated_minutes" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "todo_completions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "todo_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES todo_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "occurrence_due" INTEGER NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_plans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "day_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "intention" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_filters" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "filter_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "is_pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_pinned" IN (0, 1)), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "definition_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "planning_preferences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "timezone_id" TEXT NULL, "default_slot_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30, "week_start_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "day_start_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 480, "day_end_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1080, "buffer_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (default_slot_minutes BETWEEN 5 AND 720), CHECK (week_start_day BETWEEN 1 AND 7), CHECK (day_start_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), CHECK (day_end_minute BETWEEN 1 AND 1440), CHECK (day_end_minute > day_start_minute), CHECK (buffer_minutes BETWEEN 0 AND 240));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "working_hours" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "weekday" INTEGER NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "start_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (weekday BETWEEN 1 AND 7), CHECK (start_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), CHECK (end_minute BETWEEN 1 AND 1440), CHECK (end_minute > start_minute));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "working_breaks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "weekday" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (weekday BETWEEN 1 AND 7), CHECK (start_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), CHECK (end_minute BETWEEN 1 AND 1440), CHECK (end_minute > start_minute));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project_statuses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "status_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_token" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'blue', "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_done" IN (0, 1)), "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("project_id", "status_key"), CHECK (position >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project_milestones" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "target_date" INTEGER NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (position >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
